politics_desktop_observations.method: A hidden test client used the shipped new-world and disk save/load paths. The fixture founded three nations, set simulation inputs and invoked the handlers behind the politics and diplomacy controls. Steam was disabled in the offline test page. The checks cover controlled transitions and do not measure natural timing, visible layout or connected rooms.

walk_progression_desktop_observations.method: An isolated profile entered Walk on a generated flat map with a prepared modern capital. The fixture set hours, used Walk's interior queue and collision queries at the door, and called the character and inventory handlers. It opened a dispatcher dialogue and clicked the offer in the game window. The bus was placed at each generated stop and stepped through the shipped dwell and payout logic. Health, money and wanted stars were supplied to exercise the treatment, service and arrest paths. The fixture saved to disk during custody and reloaded through the normal boot path.

checks.name: Bus shift from a dispatcher offer through its full loop
checks.expected: Each controlled stop is accepted. Completion pays the wallet, adds three XP and records one successful shift

checks.name: Hospital treatment with and without funds

checks.name: Military service eligibility and career exclusion
